visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Position instead of margin guesses
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The label is moved to the bottom of the box with a guessed offset from the top. Use position absolute with bottom 0 inside a relative box. It must stay at the bottom edge.
visualizerParams.initialCode: Tag

solution.code: Tag
solution.explanation: A top offset guesses the distance from the top and breaks when the text size or the box height changes. bottom: 0 on a positioned element says exactly what is wanted: stay at the bottom edge.

checks.label: The label is at the bottom of the box
